action.content: Write a funny poem for kids about a product that you would like to sell. The poem should have exactly 6 stanzas. Separated the stanzas using 3 asterisk markers: ***
action.label: context

action.content:
I have a hat that talks to you,
With silly voices, loud and new!
It says "Good morning" when you wake,
And tells a joke before you take
A bite of toast or sip of tea,
The funniest hat you've ever seen!

***

It sings a song when you are sad,
About a dancing, happy tad.
It hums a tune when you are tired,
And makes your sleepy eyes get wider.
It whispers secrets in your ear,
About a dragon in your chair!

***

The hat can change its color too,
From bright blue sky to sunny view.
It turns to pink if you are shy,
Or neon green when you say "Hi!"
It matches socks and shoes and pants,
With magic tricks and silly chants.

***

No other hat can do this feat,
To make your boring day complete.
It tells a story of a cat
Who flew a kite and ate a hat.
It's full of tales and funny sounds,
The bestest hat in all the grounds!

***

So if you want a hat that's cool,
That makes your whole world feel so full,
Just come and buy it, don't delay,
It's waiting here to start your day!
With laughter loud and jokes so sweet,
It's the most fun hat that you've met!

***

So grab your cash and run right in,
To get the hat that's truly kin.
It's not just fabric, it's a friend,
The funniest hat you'll ever send!
Buy it now before it's gone,
The talking hat is here to dawn!
action.label: response
